# Metric report (generated by `runner/report_metrics.py` from the prediction artifacts)

Every value below is recomputed from the stored walk-forward forecasts on the 62 verdict quarters (2010-Q1..2026-Q3) and checked against each model's results file (max difference < 1e-9).

**Status:** PASS / FAIL = against a pre-registered threshold (accuracy ≥ 0.75, balanced accuracy ≥ 0.70, precision and recall ≥ 0.60). REPORTED = no threshold exists for this metric (F1, AUC-ROC, Brier; lower Brier is better). UNDEFINED = AUC of a constant forecast.
